record.question: In the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, unless the contact otherwise requires, 'environment' includes:
options: Water, air and land and the inter-relationship which exists among and between water, air and land, and human beings, other living creatures, plants
Water, air and land and the inter-relationship which exists among and between water, air and land, and human beings, other living creatures, plants, micro-organisms
Water, air and land and the inter-relationship which exists among and between water, air and land, and human beings, other living creatures, plants, micro-organisms and property
Water, air and land and the inter-relationship which exists among and between water, air and land, and human beings, other living creatures
